answer: An identity buys its seat with Apiarist queen cell inspection tag stamped by the county beekeepers association; the price of the seat is each queen cell is a dated inspection plus a signed yard log, so a farm must breed 5. The farm must fund 604 separate proofs before the epoch pays a single POA, a bill of 64628 POA in advance. A sonnet without a date is a rumour, a dune without a receipt is a boast, and a shale without a witness is a story. Everything above is checkable from public records; nothing here rests on trust.
